picks.title: Theory of High-Temperature Fractional Chern Phases in Monolayer van der Waals Kagome Materials A$_2$T$_3$X$_4$
picks.authors: Soomin Oh · Jiyong Han · Jinhyeok Choi · Donghae Seo · Mingu Kang · Gil Young Cho
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)
picks.why_zh: 原子尺度 vdW kagome 单层 A₂T₃X₄ 上拓扑平带 + 强库仑给出 ~26 meV 多体能隙的高温分数陈与反常复合费米液体；反平行双层通向分数量子自旋霍尔——分数陈 × 任意子 × 高温平台。
picks.summary_zh: 莫尔分数陈绝缘体因超晶格周期长、相互作用弱而困在极低温；原子尺度拓扑平带长期缺合适材料。作者把新合成的 vdW kagome 族 A₂T₃X₄ 单层指认为平台：本征拓扑平带、强库仑、门控载流与堆垛可调。由 DFT 导出模型的精确对角化显示宽填充范围铁磁，并支撑多样分数陈、反常复合费米液体与电荷有序；Cs₂Pd₃S₄ 中在允许至多一个带间电子–空穴激发的最大体系下，分数陈多体能隙约 26 meV。反平行磁化双层在现实间距下支持分数量子自旋霍尔。化学组成、载流与堆垛提供互补路径，把分数化推到更高能标并调控拓扑序。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators bring the fractional quantum Hall effect, with its anyonic excitations, to zero magnetic field. So far they have been realized in moiré materials, where the long superlattice period weakens electronic interactions and confines these phases to cryogenic temperatures. Early proposals instead envisioned topological flat bands on atomic-scale lattices, where fractionalization could persist to far higher temperatures, but a suitable material has been lacking. Here we theoretically identify monolayers of the recently synthesized van der Waals kagome family $\mathrm{A}_2\mathrm{T}_3\mathrm{X}_4$ as such a platform, combining intrinsic topological flat bands and strong Coulomb interactions with gate-tunable carrier density and layer assembly. Exact diagonalization of models derived from density functional theory reveals ferromagnetism over broad filling ranges, supporting diverse fractional Chern insulators, anomalous composite Fermi liquids, and charge-ordered phases. In particular, in $\mathrm{Cs}_2\mathrm{Pd}_3\mathrm{S}_4$, the fractional Chern insulator exhibits a many-body gap of approximately 26 meV in the largest system accessible with band mixing allowing at most one interband electron-hole excitation. Layer assembly further provides a natural route to fractional quantum spin Hall insulators: bilayers with antiparallel magnetizations support this phase at realistic separations. These results identify an experimentally accessible material family in which chemical composition, carrier density, and stacking offer complementary routes to fractionalization at enhanced energy scales and control over topological order.

picks.title: Bicircular light tunable topological phases and nonlinear Hall responses in odd-parity magnets
picks.why_zh: 双圆偏振光驱动奇宇称磁体（交错/奇波磁）级联拓扑相变，量子几何突变，并解锁 Berry 曲率与量子度规起源的非线性霍尔——altermagnetism × 光控拓扑。
picks.summary_zh: 奇波磁体动量依赖自旋劈裂取奇宇称形式因子，是非常规磁与拓扑的独立平台。作者证明双圆偏振光可在奇宇称磁体中诱导拓扑相变：两束相对振幅比连续改变时出现级联拓扑跃迁，并伴随量子度规突变。双圆偏振光进一步解锁由 Berry 曲率与量子度规贡献的非线性霍尔响应，并给出选择定则。结论是奇宇称磁体的拓扑与非线性响应均可由双圆偏振驱动直接操控。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Altermagnets are an emerging class of magnetic materials that exhibit characteristic features of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Odd-wave magnets, where the momentum-dependent spin splitting follows an odd-parity form factor, provide a distinct platform for exploring unconventional magnetic and topological phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate light-induced topological phase transitions in odd-parity magnets driven by bicircular light. We show that a cascade of topological phase transitions occur as the relative amplitude ratio of the two beams is varied. These are accompanied by sharp changes of the quantum metric. We demonstrate that bicircular light unlocks nonlinear Hall responses arising from Berry curvature and quantum metric in irradiated odd-wave magnets, and formulate the underlying selection rules. Our results show that both the topology and the nonlinear responses in odd-parity magnets can be directly controlled by a bicircular drive.

picks.title: Self-Trapping and Liouvillian Spectral Transitions in a Dissipative Bose-Hubbard Dimer
picks.why_zh: 耗散玻色–哈伯德二聚体中耗散单独即可诱导自俘获；纯耗散转变与 Liouvillian 例外点及间隙峰（量子芝诺起点）重合，相互作用下芝诺阈值相对自俘获移位——开放系统 × Liouvillian 谱。
picks.summary_zh: 双势阱自俘获通常由相互作用驱动振荡→局域。作者用平均场与精确对角化表明，耗散单独也可诱导一侧势阱的自俘获样局域（瞬态衰减但可持续较长时间）；平均场上相互作用驱动为不连续、耗散驱动为连续。二者并存时划出三区：弱相互作用下增耗散→自俘获；中等相互作用下弱/强耗散自俘获、中间振荡（重入）；强相互作用下自俘获被耗散削弱。谱上纯耗散转变与例外点及 Liouvillian 间隙峰重合（芝诺起点）；有相互作用时芝诺起点移到强于自俘获转变的耗散强度。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We study the self-trapping transition in dissipative double wells using mean-field theory and exact diagonalization. We find that, similar to the conventional interaction-driven transition from oscillatory dynamics to self-trapping, dissipation alone can also induce self-trapping-like localization in one well. The resulting state, although transient and decaying, persists for a substantial time. At the mean-field level, the interaction- and dissipation-driven transitions are discontinuous and continuous, respectively. When interaction and dissipation both are present, their interplay produces three dynamical regimes: (i) at weak interaction, increasing dissipation drives a transition from oscillations to self-trapping; (ii) at moderate interaction, self-trapping at weak dissipation, oscillatory dynamics at intermediate dissipation, and re-entrant self-trapping at strong dissipation; and (iii) at strong interaction, self-trapping persists but is weakened by dissipation. We connect the transition with the Liouvillian spectrum. It is observed that purely dissipation-driven transition coincides with an exceptional point in the spectra, and a peak in the Liouvillian gap, marking the onset of the quantum-Zeno regime. In the presence of interactions, however, the onset of the Zeno regime is shifted to dissipation strengths larger than that required for the self-trapping transition.

picks.title: Monolayer van der Waals kagome lattice for high-temperature flat-band physics
picks.authors: Hyungkun Bong · Choongjae Won · Seongyong Lee · Soomin Oh 等
picks.why_zh: nano-ARPES 首次确立 vdW kagome 族 A₂T₃X₄ 理想单层平带，门控可推至费米面，电子密度比莫尔人工平带高约 220 倍——高温分数陈/平带平台的实验伙伴。
picks.summary_zh: 真正二维 kagome 长期缺失。作者用 A₂T₃X₄（A=K,Rb,Cs；T=Ni,Pd,Pt；X=S,Se）实现理想单层 kagome：nano-ARPES 在单层极限见费米面下孤立 kagome 平带，门控可调至费米面，打开部分填充平带物理。相对莫尔人工平带，该本征平带电子密度高约 220 倍，进入新密度与能标体制。文中多体计算支持把分数量子反常霍尔等平带现象推到远高于现有平台的温度。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Kagome lattice materials host a remarkably rich landscape of novel quantum phenomena, all arising from the intrinsic interplay of topology, correlation, and frustration. While previous studies have been mostly limited to bulk three-dimensional (3D) kagome crystals, the realization of a true two-dimensional (2D) kagome system has remained a long-standing goal, to unlock fundamentally new physics and engineering pathways inaccessible in 3D systems. In this work, we establish the first ideal 2D monolayer kagome lattices by leveraging a novel and versatile van der Waals (vdW) kagome family, A2T3X4 (A = K, Rb, Cs; T = Ni, Pd, Pt; X = S, Se). Our nano-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) directly characterizes the electronic structure of A2T3X4 down to the monolayer limit, notably revealing an isolated kagome-derived flat band just below the Fermi level. Via gate-engineering of 2D A2T3X4, the kagome flat band can be further tuned to the Fermi level, allowing direct access to the partially filled flat band physics and establishing a qualitatively new 2D flat band platform. Compared to existing moire-based artificial flat band systems, this vdW kagome-based intrinsic flat band system realizes more than 220 times higher flat band electron density, opening an entirely new density and energy regime for exploring 2D flat band physics. Harnessing this high-electron-density flat band in 2D vdW kagome system provides a clear pathway to scale emergent flat band phenomena - such as fractional quantum anomalous Hall states - to far higher temperatures than currently achievable, as long-envisioned in theory and further supported by our many-body calculations.

picks.title: Hidden piezo-Hall effect
picks.authors: San-Dong Guo · Shi-Hao Zhang · Bingwen Zhang
picks.why_zh: d 波隐藏交错磁中应变诱导扇区反常霍尔、全局仍抵消的隐藏压电霍尔；RbV₂Te₂O 第一性原理验证，旋转应变翻转扇区符号——altermagnetism × 隐藏响应。
picks.summary_zh: 隐藏自旋极化已拓展出一大类隐藏现象。作者引入隐藏压电霍尔：应变使各扇区出现有限反常霍尔电导，全局仍为零；零应变下整体系与扇区皆无 AHE。对 d 波隐藏交错磁紧束缚与实验合成的 RbV₂Te₂O 第一性原理：单轴应变下扇区 AHC 相反而求和抵消；应变由 x 转 y 翻转扇区符号且不产生净霍尔。同对称机制可推广到隐藏压磁光、压热霍尔、压能斯特与压 Ettingshausen。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Extensive studies of hidden spin polarization have established a broad class of hidden phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we introduce the hidden piezo-Hall effect, in which strain induces finite anomalous Hall conductivities (AHCs) in individual sectors while the global AHC remains zero. At zero strain, neither the full system nor its sectors exhibit an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Under uniaxial strain, however, opposite sector AHCs emerge while their sum remains canceled. We establish this effect for a $d$-wave hidden altermagnet using a tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for the experimentally synthesized material $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$. Rotating the strain direction from the $x$ to the $y$ axis reverses the signs of the sector AHCs without generating a net Hall response. The same symmetry mechanism may also give rise to hidden piezomagneto-optical, piezo-thermal Hall, piezo-Nernst, and piezo-Ettingshausen effects. Our work extends hidden physics to strain-controlled transport and identifies $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$ as a promising candidate for experimental verification.

picks.title: The Anyon Atlas
picks.authors: Jonah Berean-Dutcher · Clay Cordova · Julio Parra-Martinez · Richard Tuddenham
picks.subjects: High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Quantum Algebra (math.QA)
picks.why_zh: 用 SL(2,ℤ) 同余表示数值优化，系统分类 ≤22（玻色）/≤26（费米）任意子的 2+1D TQFT 模数据，并给出超出规范理论凝聚序列的新拓扑序——任意子 × 拓扑序图鉴。
picks.summary_zh: 作者通过模/超模张量范畴的模数据，分类至多 22（玻色）与 26（费米）个任意子的 2+1 维拓扑量子场论；用可扩到高秩的数值优化从 SL(2,ℤ) 同余表示构造数据，并梳理任意子凝聚与 Chern–Simons 实现关系。发现一类模数据似乎无法由任何 Chern–Simons 理论经任意子凝聚或普通全局对称规范得到，构成超越规范理论的新 TQFT。对 11、12 种任意子的例子显式解五边形/六边形方程，确认对应幺正完整 TQFT；并发布在线 Anyon Atlas 资源。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We classify possible topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions with up to 22 anyons in the bosonic case and up to 26 in the fermionic case, through the modular data of modular and supermodular tensor categories. We construct such data via congruence representations of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ using a numerical optimization algorithm that scales to high rank. We chart the relations between the resulting theories, including anyon condensations and Chern-Simons realizations. We find examples of modular data that do not appear to arise from any Chern-Simons theory by any sequence of condensations of anyons or gaugings of ordinary global symmetries. These examples give qualitatively new topological quantum field theories, which go beyond any notion of gauge theory. For examples in this class with 11 and 12 anyon types, we solve the pentagon and hexagon equations explicitly, showing that these modular data are realized by full unitary topological quantum field theories. We also introduce this https URL , an online resource for exploring the data.

picks.title: Topological Quantum Gates on FCIs with Bounded Quantum Geometry
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)
picks.why_zh: 两带 2D FCI 中沿布里渊区原胞循环约束积分量子度规，可把 |C|>1 的拓扑序细化到 |C| 个循环置换的编织观测量，并分类含非 Clifford T/CCZ 的量子门——分数陈 × 拓扑量子计算。
picks.summary_zh: 两带二维分数陈绝缘体原则上可承载与动量空间 Bloch Hopfion 相关的非常规任意子序。作者证明：沿一个原胞布里渊区循环约束积分量子度规，可将该拓扑序细化为 |C| 个编织观测量，并由晶格平移循环置换（|C|>1），给出轻度非阿贝尔编织相位，并与杂化 Wannier 态谱流及实空间扩展界一致。据此分类原则上可实现的量子门，其中包括非 Clifford 的 T 门与纠缠 CCZ 门，指向在已知 FCI 轨道结构内的容错路径。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Two-band 2D fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) have recently been shown, in principle, to admit unusual anyonic order, associated with Bloch Hopfions localized in momentum space. Here we show that bounding the integrated quantum metric along one primitive Brillouin-zone cycle may refine this topological order to $|C|$ distinct braiding observables, cyclically permuted by lattice translations, for Chern numbers $|C| > 1$. The cyclic structure entails mildly non-abelian braiding phases and otherwise matches the spectral flow exhibited by the FCI's hybrid Wannier states, with the metric bound equivalently a bound on the states' real-space spread. We give a classification of quantum gates in principle implementable on this topological order; among them we find the non-Clifford T-gate and the non-Clifford entangling CCZ-gate. This points to novel pathways to fault-tolerant quantum processes within the known orbital structure of FCIs, potentially informing experimental searches towards hardware for future topological quantum computers.

picks.title: Exploring ground state phase diagrams of Rydberg atom arrays with finite projected entangled-pair states
picks.authors: Konrad Schröder · Erik Lennart Weerda · Matteo Rizzi
picks.subjects: Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 采样优化有限 PEPS 处理长程相互作用，在 Rydberg 原子阵列受挫几何上探 Kagomé 自旋玻璃与 Ruby 格点超越 PXP 的拓扑序——张量网络 × 量子模拟数字孪生。
picks.summary_zh: 二维 Rydberg 阵列基态数值困难，长程相互作用对区分竞争相至关重要。作者用采样优化的投影纠缠对态（PEPS）同等对待长短程项，探究受挫几何上的争论：Kagomé 上自旋玻璃物理，以及 Ruby 格点上超越 PXP 模型的拓扑序。工作推动把 PEPS 建成 Rydberg 实验的数字孪生工具。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Rydberg atom arrays (RAA) have been advocated as a promising avenue for the quantum simulation of different exotic quantum states. Numerical predictions for the ground state properties of this experimental platform can, however, be challenging in two-dimensional setups. In particular, faithfully treating long-range interactions is often crucial for distinguishing the fate of competing phases, but it usually comes at considerable cost. Projected entangled-pair states (PEPS), optimized via a sampling-based approach, have been shown to deal with such terms on the same ground as shorter-range ones. In this work, we employ these tools to investigate debated physical questions in different frustrated geometries of RAA, from the emergence of spin-glass physics on the Kagomé lattice to topological order beyond the PXP model on the Ruby lattice. By that, we contribute to establishing PEPS as well-suited tools for creating digital twins of RAA experiments.

picks.title: A Chiral Superlattice Route to Spin-Split Topological Antiferromagnetism
picks.authors: Thao Dinh · Mengke Liu · Jian-Xiang Qiu · Sougata Mardanya 等
picks.why_zh: UOTe 共线反铁磁经自发手性超晶格（冻结手性声子）产生大 Berry 曲率与自旋劈裂：非线性霍尔探测，T_N 附近巨反常霍尔角 ~0.14，自旋 Hanle 见自旋极化流——自旋电子学 × 拓扑反铁磁。
picks.summary_zh: 原始 UOTe 为无 Berry 曲率、无自旋劈裂带的共线反铁磁。作者发现自发手性超晶格（可视为有限波矢冻结手性声子）：电子波函数与量子几何被强调制，产生大手性超晶格 Berry 曲率，由非线性霍尔探测。约 150 K 该 Berry 曲率与共线反铁磁耦合，在 T_N 附近突然给出体磁体中最大量级之一的反常霍尔角 ~0.14；自旋 Hanle 进动显示手性超晶格还能从共线反铁磁产生自旋极化电流。并给出基于离子尺寸与层间/层内能量竞争的超调制形成机制与键失配超晶格设计原则。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: The interplay between chirality and magnetism is a profound topic, spanning particle physics, condensed matter, chemistry and origin of life. In this paper, we study this interplay in the new antiferromagnet (AFM) UOTe, and we report a chiral superlattice route to spin-split topological phenomena from collinear antiferromagnetism. Pristine UOTe is a collinear AFM without Berry curvature or spin-split bands. However, we identify the spontaneous formation of a chiral superlattice in UOTe, which can be viewed as frozen chiral phonons at finite wave vector. When electrons move through the chiral superlattice, their orbital Bloch wavefunction and quantum geometry are modulated by the strong chiral superlattice potential, generating large Berry curvature in the chiral superlattice, which we detect by the nonlinear Hall effect. At 150 K, the chiral superlattice induced Berry curvature couples to the collinear AFM order, generating a giant anomalous Hall angle ~0.14 abruptly near $T_N$ that is among the largest in bulk magnets. Moreover, our spin Hanle precession measurement shows that the chiral superlattice also generates spin-polarized current from the collinear AFM, a long-standing goal in spintronics. We shed light on the supermodulation formation mechanism based on chemical ion size and physical interlayer-intralayer energy competitions, using which we propose a design principle to discover similar bond-mismatch superlattices, providing a chiral superlattice pathway through real space engineering of quantum geometry.

picks.title: Non-Markovian exceptional points and information backflow: a Heisenberg reaction-coordinate approach
picks.authors: Daniel Holst · Gianmichele Blasi · Shishir Khandelwal
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)
picks.why_zh: 反应坐标 + 海森堡方程解析非马尔可夫例外点：澄清 EP 并不普遍标志信息回涌起点，并给出高阶 EP 回涌界与不可逆信息损失可控——非厄米/开放 × 例外点。
picks.summary_zh: 开放系统例外点多在马尔可夫主方程框架讨论；非马尔可夫情形常用赝模。作者用反应坐标形式的海森堡方程得到精确解析动力学，分析较主方程更简。讨论二阶与高阶 EP 下的非马尔可夫回涌，表明“EP 标志回涌起点”并不普遍成立；进而给出高阶非马尔可夫 EP 的回涌次数界，并考察高阶 EP 附近渐近弛豫增强。最后研究工程化库中的非马尔可夫 EP，说明可用于调控不可逆信息损失速率。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: The primary pathway to the investigation of exceptional points (EPs) in open quantum systems has been the use of Markovian master equations. However, recently it has been realised that they can arise in settings that show non-Markovian behaviour. The main approach in this direction has been the use of pseudomodes, which allow the influence of a structured environment to be replaced by new damped auxiliary modes. In this work, we use a Heisenberg-equation approach which relies on the reaction-coordinate formalism to obtain exact analytical dynamics. First, we show how our method considerably simplifies the analysis compared to the use of master equations. Second, we utilise it to discuss non-Markovian revivals in systems with second and higher-order EPs, showing that the notion that EPs demarcate the onset of revivals is not generally true. We then utilise our results to discuss the dynamical effects of higher-order non-Markovian EPs, deriving bounds on the number of revivals and investigating enhanced asymptotic relaxation near higher-order EPs. Finally, we investigate non-Markovian EPs with engineered reservoirs and show how they can be utilised to control the rate of irreversible information loss.

picks.title: Vortexable Chern Bands Sit Exactly on the Topological Floor of Flat-Band Superfluid Stiffness
picks.subjects: Superconductivity (cond-mat.supr-con) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)
picks.why_zh: 可涡旋 Chern 带在固定 C、填充与配对振幅下恰落在平带超流刚度的拓扑下界；偏离涡旋性才可能增强刚度——分数陈理想带 × 平带超导。
picks.summary_zh: 可涡旋 Chern 带承载理想分数陈绝缘体。与时间反演伙伴经轨道对角原位吸引配对后，在固定陈数 C、填充与配对振幅下，它们是刚度最低的平带超导体。均匀配对且配对态非简并时，精确 T=0 刚度行列式等于拓扑下界乘以 ≤1 的涡旋性偏离因子；增强刚度必须以牺牲涡旋性为代价，且不等式仅在内部分量共享格点（如异质应变双层）时严格。

picks.abstract: Vortexable Chern bands host ideal fractional Chern insulators. Paired with time-reversed partners by orbital-diagonal on-site attraction, they are the least stiff flat-band superconductors at fixed Chern number $C$, filling, and pairing amplitude. For uniform pairing and a nondegenerate paired state, the exact $T=0$ stiffness determinant is the topological floor times $1+(\Torb/2\pi|C|)^2\le1+(\TLVP/2\pi|C|)^2$, where $\Torb$ and $\TLVP$ measure departures from vortexability. Enhancement costs vortexability, and the inequality is strict only if internal components share a site, as in heterostrained bilayers.
